extraction: exact LS/MAP/AL JavaScript literals; no inferred components

F2-04: decimal blocks are a preset of base-ten blocks
F5-16: percentage bar with an unknown original
F4-10: equation overlay on the algebra bar
F18-09: currency is a bridge with a rate
F8-02: inverse flowchart is the machine reversed
F1-12: two lines stacked on one engine
F6-08: proportion graph is y = mx with c = 0
F15-03: distance on a grid is the same picture
F8-13: algebraic bases in the index animator

F7-05: double bracket is the area model
F7-09: negative and unknown weights are a mode
F7-10: cups and counters is a skin

Y7-001.title: Place value in integers and decimals
Y7-001.objective: Understand the base-10 place-value system on both sides of the decimal point.
Y7-001.scope: Read, write and partition integers and decimals; identify digit values; use zero as a placeholder; explain ×10/÷10 relationships between adjacent places.
Y7-001.namedActivity: Digit Vault: drag digit cards into place-value slots to match a target number and unlock the safe.

Y7-002.title: Scaling by powers of 10
Y7-002.objective: Use place value to explain scaling by 10, 100 and 1000.
Y7-002.scope: Keep the decimal point fixed; move digits through place-value columns; predict the size of the result.
Y7-002.namedActivity: Decimal Gates: fire numbers through ×10 and ÷10 gates and slide the digits into the right columns before the timer ends.

Y7-003.title: Comparing and ordering numbers
Y7-003.objective: Compare and order positive integers and decimals using place value.
Y7-003.scope: Align place values; use <, > and =; use trailing zeros where helpful; justify comparisons from the first place where values differ.
Y7-003.namedActivity: Number Bouncer: drag cards into order on a rail; a wrong order bounces back with a clue about the first different digit.

Y7-004.title: Number lines and negative values
Y7-004.objective: Use a number line to locate and order positive and negative values.
Y7-004.scope: Read scales; place integers and decimals; interpret distance from zero.
Y7-004.namedActivity: Lift Operator: send a lift above and below ground to riders' floors, placing each stop on the number line.

Y7-005.title: Rounding whole numbers and decimals
Y7-005.objective: Round whole numbers and decimals to a stated place value using landmarks and midpoint reasoning.
Y7-005.scope: Identify the rounding place; locate adjacent rounded values; use midpoint/distance evidence; explain halfway cases.
Y7-005.namedActivity: Rolling Rounder: roll a ball to the nearest landmark on a hill; halfway values tip it over, so you must justify the call.

Y7-006.title: Estimation and order of magnitude
Y7-006.objective: Use rounding to predict the approximate size of a calculation.
Y7-006.scope: Choose sensible rounding; estimate before calculating; judge whether an answer is reasonable.
Y7-006.namedActivity: Guess the Size: slide an estimate before the answer is revealed; the closer you are, the bigger your combo.

Y7-007.title: Adding and subtracting whole numbers
Y7-007.objective: Use efficient mental and formal written methods for addition and subtraction of whole numbers.
Y7-007.scope: Partition strategically; align place values; exchange between columns; interpret subtraction as difference or removal; check with inverse operations.
Y7-007.namedActivity: Column Crunch: exchange blocks between columns to rebuild the answer before the machine jams.

Y7-008.title: Adding and subtracting decimals
Y7-008.objective: Add and subtract decimals by aligning equal-sized places.
Y7-008.scope: Align decimal points because place values align; use placeholder zeros; estimate to check.
Y7-008.namedActivity: Align the Dots: drop decimals into aligned columns; misaligned points explode, aligned ones add up.

Y7-009.title: Multiplying whole numbers and decimals
Y7-009.objective: Use place-value reasoning and efficient written methods to multiply whole numbers and decimals.
Y7-009.scope: Interpret multiplication as equal groups; use distributive structure and partial products; estimate size; place decimal results by value.
Y7-009.namedActivity: Partial Product Bakery: slice an area into parts, bake each product, then add them to fill the order.

Y7-010.title: Dividing whole numbers and decimals
Y7-010.objective: Use grouping, sharing and place-value reasoning to divide whole numbers and decimals.
Y7-010.scope: Use inverse multiplication facts; record remainders appropriately; scale equivalent divisions where useful; interpret decimal quotients and check by estimation.
Y7-010.namedActivity: Share the Loot: deal loot into equal groups and decide what to do with the leftovers.

Y7-011.title: Adding and subtracting negative numbers
Y7-011.objective: Model signed changes and calculate with negative numbers.
Y7-011.scope: Use number-line movement; distinguish operation signs from number signs; cross zero accurately.
Y7-011.namedActivity: Zero Crossing Run: hop along a number line across zero, picking jump directions to collect coins.

Y7-012.title: Multiplying and dividing negative numbers
Y7-012.objective: Calculate products and quotients involving negative numbers and explain sign patterns.
Y7-012.scope: Generalise sign rules from patterns; separate magnitude from sign; apply to mixed calculations.
Y7-012.namedActivity: Sign Detective: complete sign-pattern tables, state the rule, then use it to open mixed-calculation locks.

Y7-013.title: Factors and multiples
Y7-013.objective: Distinguish factors from multiples and find them systematically.
Y7-013.scope: Use arrays/divisibility; list factor pairs; generate multiples and common multiples.
Y7-013.namedActivity: Factor Fishing: catch only factors or multiples of the target number; wrong catches are thrown back.

Y7-014.title: Prime numbers
Y7-014.objective: Recognise prime and composite numbers from their factor structure.
Y7-014.scope: Use the definition of prime; identify 1 as neither prime nor composite; test numbers efficiently.
Y7-014.namedActivity: Prime Sieve Sweep: sweep a grid to cross out multiples; the survivors light up as primes before time runs out.

Y7-015.title: Prime factorisation
Y7-015.objective: Express integers as products of prime factors.
Y7-015.scope: Build factor trees; use index notation; recognise equivalent decompositions.
Y7-015.namedActivity: Prime Tree Climb: split a number into branches until every leaf is prime; fewest splits wins.

Y7-016.title: HCF and LCM
Y7-016.objective: Use factors and prime decomposition to find highest common factors and lowest common multiples.
Y7-016.scope: Identify shared prime factors for HCF; build the smallest complete shared multiple for LCM; choose efficient methods and interpret grouping/repeating contexts.
Y7-016.namedActivity: Venn Vault: drop prime factors into a two-circle Venn to forge the HCF and LCM keys.

Y7-017.title: Squares, cubes and roots
Y7-017.objective: Use square/cube numbers and associated roots.
Y7-017.scope: Recognise common powers; connect area/volume models; distinguish exact roots from approximations.
Y7-017.namedActivity: Tower Builder: stack blocks into squares and cubes, matching each to its number and root to raise the tower.

Y7-018.title: Priority of operations
Y7-018.objective: Apply brackets, powers, roots, reciprocals and operation priority correctly.
Y7-018.scope: Read expressions structurally; work left-to-right within equal priority; explain why different orders change results.
Y7-018.namedActivity: BIDMAS Bomb Squad: cut the wires in the correct operation order to defuse the expression.

Y7-019.title: Fractions as numbers
Y7-019.objective: Interpret proper, improper and mixed fractions as numbers.
Y7-019.scope: Locate fractions on number lines; convert mixed/improper forms; identify numerator and denominator roles.
Y7-019.namedActivity: Slice Shop: fill pizza and chocolate orders by cutting wholes into equal parts and shading the fraction.

Y7-020.title: Equivalent and simplified fractions
Y7-020.objective: Recognise, generate and simplify equivalent fractions without changing their value.
Y7-020.scope: Scale or divide numerator and denominator by the same factor; use visual models; use common factors/HCF; recognise fully simplified form.
Y7-020.namedActivity: Equivalent Match: flip cards to pair equivalent fractions; the multiplier is shown when you match.

Y7-021.title: Comparing and ordering fractions
Y7-021.objective: Compare fractions using common denominators, benchmarks or equivalent forms.
Y7-021.scope: Choose an efficient representation; order fractions; justify comparisons.
Y7-021.namedActivity: Fraction Face-off: two fractions battle on a line and you drag the bigger one to win the round.

Y7-022.title: Adding and subtracting fractions
Y7-022.objective: Add and subtract fractions by creating equal-sized parts first.
Y7-022.scope: Find common denominators; transform each fraction separately; simplify and check the result.
Y7-022.namedActivity: Common Slice Chef: re-slice two pizzas to the same size slices, then combine them to serve the order.

Y7-023.title: Multiplying fractions
Y7-023.objective: Multiply fractions and interpret a fraction of a fraction.
Y7-023.scope: Use area/bar models; multiply numerators and denominators with meaning; simplify efficiently.
Y7-023.namedActivity: Part-of-a-Part: shade overlaps in a grid to find fraction products and hit target areas.

Y7-024.title: Dividing fractions
Y7-024.objective: Interpret division by a fraction and calculate quotients.
Y7-024.scope: Connect to how many groups fit; use reciprocal multiplication with explanation; check by inverse.
Y7-024.namedActivity: How Many Fit?: pour fractional scoops into a container and count how many fit to learn division.

Y7-025.title: Converting fractions, decimals and percentages
Y7-025.objective: Move accurately between common fractions, terminating decimals and percentages.
Y7-025.scope: Use place value and division; interpret percent as parts per hundred; use ×100/÷100 appropriately; recognise common equivalents and compare representations.
Y7-025.namedActivity: FDP Factory: route items on a conveyor to the matching fraction, decimal or percentage bin.

Y7-026.title: Percentage of an amount
Y7-026.objective: Find a percentage of a quantity using multiplicative methods.
Y7-026.scope: Use 10%, 5%, 1% and multipliers; choose efficient decomposition; interpret context.
Y7-026.namedActivity: Sale Hunter: use 10% blocks to price sale items, fastest correct total grabs the deal.

Y7-027.title: One quantity as a percentage of another
Y7-027.objective: Express one quantity as a percentage of another and interpret percentages above 100%.
Y7-027.scope: Form part/whole fraction; convert to percent; explain comparison meaning.
Y7-027.namedActivity: Score Tracker: turn test scores into percentages to earn level badges.

Y7-028.title: Algebraic notation and mathematical language
Y7-028.objective: Read and write algebraic notation and distinguish expressions, equations, identities and formulae.
Y7-028.scope: Use variable, coefficient, term, expression, equation and formula precisely; write products/powers conventionally; interpret equality and identify what can be simplified or solved.
Y7-028.namedActivity: Algebra Translator: decode word clues into expressions and drop each on the matching crate.

Y7-029.title: Collecting like terms
Y7-029.objective: Simplify expressions by combining like terms only.
Y7-029.scope: Identify matching variable parts; combine coefficients; explain why unlike terms cannot combine.
Y7-029.namedActivity: Like Terms Sort: drag tiles into like-term groups, then crush each group into a simplified expression.

Y7-030.title: Substitution into expressions and formulae
Y7-030.objective: Substitute numerical values into expressions and formulae accurately.
Y7-030.scope: Use brackets for negative values; follow operation priority; identify variables and units; evaluate powers; interpret results in context.
Y7-030.namedActivity: Formula Machine: feed values into the machine and predict the output before it runs.

Y7-031.title: Expanding a single bracket
Y7-031.objective: Use the distributive law to expand a single bracket.
Y7-031.scope: Multiply every term inside the bracket; connect area/group models to symbols; simplify afterward.
Y7-031.namedActivity: Bracket Builder: fill an area rectangle to expand a bracket and match it to the expression cards.

Y7-032.title: Factorising a common factor
Y7-032.objective: Reverse expansion by taking out a common factor.
Y7-032.scope: Find the greatest useful common factor; write equivalent bracketed expressions; check by re-expanding.
Y7-032.namedActivity: Rectangle Factoriser: arrange tiles into a rectangle and read the factors off its sides.

Y7-033.title: Solving one-step and two-step equations
Y7-033.objective: Solve one-step and two-step linear equations by maintaining equality and using inverse operations.
Y7-033.scope: Choose inverse operations; undo operations in a logical order; show balanced steps; check solutions by substitution.
Y7-033.namedActivity: Balance Buster: keep the scale level by doing the same to both sides until x stands alone.

Y7-034.title: Forming expressions from contexts
Y7-034.objective: Translate verbal and geometric relationships into algebraic expressions.
Y7-034.scope: Identify variable quantities; represent repeated amounts; distinguish fixed and changing values.
Y7-034.namedActivity: Story to Expression: choose the expression that matches a short story; wrong picks show the contradiction.

Y7-035.title: Forming and solving equations from contexts
Y7-035.objective: Translate contextual relationships into linear equations and solve them.
Y7-035.scope: Choose an unknown; represent both sides; solve while maintaining equality; interpret and check the answer in context.
Y7-035.namedActivity: Mystery Number Case: set up and solve equations from clues to open each case file.

Y7-036.title: Sequence rules and structure
Y7-036.objective: Generate and recognise common sequence structures using precise term-to-term rules.
Y7-036.scope: Continue sequences forwards/backwards; identify additive or multiplicative change; recognise arithmetic, geometric and familiar special sequences; describe rules precisely.
Y7-036.namedActivity: Pattern Predictor: grow a pattern, shoot the next term, and reveal the rule on a hit.

Y7-037.title: Nth term of a linear sequence
Y7-037.objective: Find and use the nth term of a linear sequence.
Y7-037.scope: Link constant difference to coefficient of n; find the adjustment; test the rule on multiple terms.
Y7-037.namedActivity: nth Term Machine: tune the a and b dials until the machine's output matches the sequence.

Y7-038.title: Coordinates and shapes
Y7-038.objective: Read, plot and reason with coordinates in all four quadrants.
Y7-038.scope: Use x before y; work with negative coordinates and equal scales; plot vertices; infer missing coordinates using shape properties.
Y7-038.namedActivity: Treasure Coordinates: plot points in order to reveal a hidden shape on the map.

Y7-039.title: Tables of values and straight-line graphs
Y7-039.objective: Generate coordinate pairs from simple rules and use them to plot straight-line graphs.
Y7-039.scope: Substitute x-values; organise tables systematically; choose scales; plot accurately; connect equation, table and graph representations.
Y7-039.namedActivity: Line Rider: plot a table of values and roll a marble along the straight line you drew.

Y7-040.title: Measuring and drawing angles
Y7-040.objective: Measure and construct angles accurately with a protractor.
Y7-040.scope: Identify angle type; position the protractor correctly; read the correct scale.
Y7-040.namedActivity: Protractor Pro: measure given angles, then draw to a target; accuracy earns stars.

Y7-041.title: Angles on lines and at a point
Y7-041.objective: Use angle facts on a straight line, around a point and vertically opposite.
Y7-041.scope: Form equations from angle facts; calculate missing angles; justify each step.
Y7-041.namedActivity: Angle Facts Shootout: find unknown angles on lines and around points using the 180 and 360 targets.

Y7-042.title: Angles in parallel lines
Y7-042.objective: Use corresponding and alternate angle relationships in parallel lines.
Y7-042.scope: Recognise transversals; identify equal/supplementary angles; reason with diagrams.
Y7-042.namedActivity: Parallel Line Puzzle: colour matching angle pairs on parallel lines and fill all unknowns to escape.

Y7-043.title: Angles in triangles
Y7-043.objective: Use the angle sum of a triangle to find unknown angles.
Y7-043.scope: Apply to isosceles/equilateral triangles; combine with line facts; explain reasoning.
Y7-043.namedActivity: Triangle Tear: tear off corners to see 180°, then find missing angles to cross the bridge.

Y7-044.title: Angles in quadrilaterals and polygons
Y7-044.objective: Use angle properties of quadrilaterals and simple polygons.
Y7-044.scope: Use quadrilateral sum; decompose polygons into triangles; find missing angles.
Y7-044.namedActivity: Polygon Walker: guide a robot round a polygon by calculating each turn so the path closes.

Y7-045.title: Properties of 2-D shapes
Y7-045.objective: Classify triangles, quadrilaterals and polygons by properties.
Y7-045.scope: Use sides, angles, parallel/perpendicular lines and symmetry; reason from definitions.
Y7-045.namedActivity: Shape Detective: identify a mystery shape by asking property questions, fewest guesses wins.

Y7-046.title: Perimeter
Y7-046.objective: Calculate and solve perimeter problems with 2-D shapes.
Y7-046.scope: Add boundary lengths; form missing-length equations; use consistent units.
Y7-046.namedActivity: Fence the Field: build a boundary on a grid to meet a perimeter target within budget.

Y7-047.title: Area of common 2-D shapes
Y7-047.objective: Calculate areas of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms and trapezia using structure rather than isolated formula memorisation.
Y7-047.scope: Use base and perpendicular height correctly; connect shapes by rearrangement; select and apply the correct area relationship.
Y7-047.namedActivity: Tile the Floor: cover rooms with the right shapes and use area formulas to price them fast.

Y7-048.title: Compound area and perimeter
Y7-048.objective: Decompose compound shapes to calculate area and perimeter.
Y7-048.scope: Choose useful partitions; avoid counting internal edges in perimeter; combine units correctly.
Y7-048.namedActivity: Compound Courtyard: split an L-shaped plot into rectangles and find area and perimeter to win the contract.

Y7-049.title: Volume of cuboids
Y7-049.objective: Calculate volume of cuboids from layer structure.
Y7-049.scope: Use length×width×height; interpret cubic units; solve missing-dimension problems.
Y7-049.namedActivity: Cube Packer: pack cuboid boxes into a truck; the best volume score wins.

Y7-050.title: Time, clocks and timetables
Y7-050.objective: Calculate with time using 12-hour and 24-hour clocks, timetables and elapsed time.
Y7-050.scope: Read analogue and digital clocks; convert between 12-hour and 24-hour time; find elapsed time by jumping to the next hour; read timetables and plan journeys; convert between hours, minutes and seconds including decimal and fraction forms.
Y7-050.namedActivity: Platform Panic: read the timetable board, work out elapsed times and send each traveller to the right train before it leaves.

Y7-051.title: Converting units
Y7-051.objective: Convert standard units of length, area and volume.
Y7-051.scope: Use multiplicative scale factors; square/cube the conversion factor appropriately; estimate reasonableness.
Y7-051.namedActivity: Unit Bridge: convert mismatched units to place each plank and cross the river.

Y7-052.title: Reflection and translation
Y7-052.objective: Describe and perform reflections and translations on coordinate grids.
Y7-052.scope: Use mirror lines; preserve size/orientation properties; express translations consistently.
Y7-052.namedActivity: Mirror Maze: reflect and slide shapes to steer a light beam through the maze.

Y7-053.title: Rotation
Y7-053.objective: Describe and perform rotations about a given centre.
Y7-053.scope: Identify centre, angle and direction; track corresponding points; preserve shape and size.
Y7-053.namedActivity: Spin Doctor: rotate shapes about a centre to fit the matching holes.

Y7-054.title: Enlargement
Y7-054.objective: Construct and describe enlargements using a positive scale factor.
Y7-054.scope: Use a centre where given; scale distances consistently; distinguish enlargement from isometric transformations.
Y7-054.namedActivity: Enlarge Lab: resize photos with scale factors to fit the frames, choosing centre and factor.

Y7-055.title: Symmetry
Y7-055.objective: Identify and construct line and rotational symmetry.
Y7-055.scope: Find lines of symmetry; determine order of rotational symmetry; use shape properties.
Y7-055.namedActivity: Symmetry Studio: complete logo designs using mirror lines and rotations.

Y7-056.title: Ruler-and-compass constructions
Y7-056.objective: Carry out standard geometric constructions accurately.
Y7-056.scope: Use compass arcs and straightedge methods to construct standard geometric objects and explain the construction steps.
Y7-056.namedActivity: Compass Cracker: use the virtual compass and ruler to build a construction that opens the door.

Y7-057.title: Introduction to congruence
Y7-057.objective: Recognise congruent shapes as identical in size and shape.
Y7-057.scope: Match corresponding sides and angles; distinguish congruence from similarity and transformation position.
Y7-057.namedActivity: Congruence Court: shapes go on trial; move, flip and turn to prove two are identical.

Y7-058.title: Ratio notation and simplifying ratios
Y7-058.objective: Represent multiplicative comparisons with ratio notation and simplify ratios without changing the relationship.
Y7-058.scope: Write ratios in a consistent order; convert to common units when needed; divide all parts by a common factor; recognise equivalent ratios.
Y7-058.namedActivity: Ratio Mixer: mix paint in the given ratios to match each colour swatch.

Y7-059.title: Sharing in a ratio
Y7-059.objective: Divide a quantity in a given ratio.
Y7-059.scope: Find total number of parts; calculate one part; allocate and check total.
Y7-059.namedActivity: Treasure Split: share a chest of gold between pirates in a given ratio.

Y7-060.title: Direct proportion
Y7-060.objective: Recognise and solve direct proportion problems.
Y7-060.scope: Use scale factors; build proportion tables/double number lines; identify multiplicative relationships.
Y7-060.namedActivity: Recipe Rush: scale a recipe up or down for different guest numbers before time runs out.

Y7-061.title: Unit price and best buy
Y7-061.scope: Calculate price per unit; keep units consistent; justify best-value decisions.
Y7-061.namedActivity: Best Buy Battle: compare unit prices on a shelf and drop the best deal into your trolley.

Y7-062.title: Percentage increase, decrease and multipliers
Y7-062.objective: Use percentage change and multipliers to increase or decrease quantities.
Y7-062.scope: Find change amounts and final amounts; connect multipliers to percentage change; choose efficient mental or calculator methods.
Y7-062.namedActivity: Multiplier Market: apply multipliers to price tags for discounts and markups, then check against the bar.

Y7-063.title: Simple interest
Y7-063.scope: Find fixed interest per period; distinguish principal, rate and time; compare totals.
Y7-063.namedActivity: Savings Safe: set the principal and rate and predict the balance year by year.

Y7-064.title: Scale drawings and maps
Y7-064.objective: Use scale factors to interpret and construct scale drawings.
Y7-064.scope: Convert between drawing and real lengths; use map scales; check units.
Y7-064.namedActivity: Map Quest: use the map scale to measure routes and work out real distances to the treasure.

Y7-065.title: Collecting and organising data
Y7-065.objective: Collect and organise data using tallies and frequency tables.
Y7-065.scope: Define categories; record frequencies accurately; distinguish raw data from summaries.
Y7-065.namedActivity: Survey Studio: design a survey, collect responses and tally them correctly into a table.

Y7-066.title: Bar charts and pictograms
Y7-066.objective: Construct and interpret bar charts and pictograms.
Y7-066.scope: Choose scales/keys; label axes; read and compare frequencies.
Y7-066.namedActivity: Chart Builder: choose the right chart and scale to display raw data cleanly.

Y7-067.title: Pie charts
Y7-067.objective: Construct and interpret pie charts using fractions, percentages and angles.
Y7-067.scope: Convert frequency to sector angle; check total 360°; solve comparison problems.
Y7-067.namedActivity: Pie Slicer: turn data into angles and slice the pie accurately with a protractor.

Y7-068.title: Stem-and-leaf diagrams
Y7-068.scope: Use an ordered key; preserve original values; read median/range from the display.
Y7-068.namedActivity: Leafy Stems: build stem-and-leaf plots from raw data to unlock the next dataset.

Y7-069.title: Mean, median, mode and range
Y7-069.objective: Calculate and interpret measures of centre and spread.
Y7-069.scope: Choose appropriate average; recognise effect of outliers; compare what each measure tells us.
Y7-069.namedActivity: Average Arena: change the numbers to hit a target mean, median or mode.

Y7-070.title: Comparing distributions
Y7-070.objective: Compare data sets using suitable measures and features.
Y7-070.scope: Use averages, range and distribution shape to make evidence-based comparisons.
Y7-070.namedActivity: Team Showdown: compare two teams' averages and range to argue who is better.

Y7-071.title: Misleading graphs
Y7-071.objective: Identify and explain how graph choices can mislead.
Y7-071.scope: Inspect scales, axes, truncation, area and presentation choices; explain how they affect interpretation.
Y7-071.namedActivity: Spot the Trick: find the cut axis or odd scale in a misleading graph and fix it.

Y7-072.title: Line graphs and trends
Y7-072.objective: Construct and interpret line graphs for changing quantities.
Y7-072.scope: Use continuous scales; identify trends/rates; interpolate cautiously.
Y7-072.namedActivity: Trend Tracker: read a line graph, predict the next point and justify the trend.

Y7-073.title: Probability scale and complements
Y7-073.objective: Represent likelihood on the 0–1 scale and use complementary probabilities.
Y7-073.scope: Place events on the probability scale; use certain/impossible/even chance; use mutually exclusive outcomes and probabilities summing to one.
Y7-073.namedActivity: Likelihood Line: place events on the probability scale and use complements to find the missing outcome.

Y7-074.title: Systematic listing and sample spaces
Y7-074.scope: Use lists/tables/grids; avoid omissions/duplicates; count equally likely outcomes.
Y7-074.namedActivity: Outcome Hunter: list every outcome systematically with no repeats to fill the sample grid.

Y7-075.title: Combined events
Y7-075.objective: Calculate probabilities from combined-event sample spaces.
Y7-075.scope: Use grids/tree-like representations; distinguish single from combined outcomes; simplify probabilities.
Y7-075.namedActivity: Double Dice Duel: predict the chance of a two-dice result, then compare with simulated rolls.

Y7-076.title: Experimental probability and relative frequency
Y7-076.objective: Use experimental results to estimate probability.
Y7-076.scope: Calculate relative frequency; compare experimental and theoretical values; explain effect of more trials.
Y7-076.namedActivity: Roll Until It Settles: run big batches and watch relative frequency settle towards theory.

Y7-077.title: Probability from two-way tables
Y7-077.scope: Identify correct totals/subsets; form probabilities from frequencies; interpret categories accurately.
Y7-077.namedActivity: Two-Way Mystery: fill missing cells in a two-way table and use it to answer probability cases.

Y8-001.title: Index notation and repeated multiplication
Y8-001.objective: Use index notation to represent repeated multiplication.
Y8-001.scope: Identify base/exponent; expand powers; evaluate integer powers accurately.
Y8-001.namedActivity: Power Stack: build towers by repeated multiplication and match each to its index notation.

Y8-002.title: Laws of indices
Y8-002.objective: Use multiplication and division laws for powers with the same base.
Y8-002.scope: Join/remove factor groups; add/subtract exponents with meaning; check by expansion.
Y8-002.namedActivity: Index Law Duel: merge power blocks and pick the correct law before the clock runs out.

Y8-003.title: Standard form and comparing standard-form numbers
Y8-003.objective: Represent, compare and order large and small numbers in standard form.
Y8-003.scope: Convert between ordinary and standard form; identify coefficient and power of ten; compare powers first and coefficients when powers match.
Y8-003.namedActivity: Scientist's Scale: write huge and tiny numbers in standard form and order them on a zoom line.

Y8-004.title: Prime factors, HCF and LCM
Y8-004.objective: Use prime factorisation to solve HCF and LCM problems efficiently.
Y8-004.scope: Use product/index notation; distinguish shared/all factors; apply to grouping and cycle contexts.
Y8-004.namedActivity: Factor Forge: forge keys from prime factors; the HCF opens a door and the LCM starts a machine.

Y8-005.title: Adding and subtracting mixed-number fractions
Y8-005.objective: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers accurately.
Y8-005.scope: Convert between mixed and improper forms where useful; create common denominators; combine equal-sized parts; simplify results.
Y8-005.namedActivity: Mixed Number Mixer: add and subtract mixed numbers with bars, regrouping wholes to fill orders.

Y8-006.title: Multiplying and dividing mixed-number fractions
Y8-006.objective: Multiply and divide fractions and mixed numbers accurately.
Y8-006.scope: Convert mixed numbers when needed; interpret multiplication and division; use reciprocal multiplication with meaning; simplify efficiently.
Y8-006.namedActivity: Fraction Scaler: multiply and divide mixed numbers, converting to improper fractions to power up.

Y8-007.title: Percentage multipliers
Y8-007.objective: Use multipliers for increase and decrease.
Y8-007.scope: Translate percentage changes into decimal factors; perform one-step changes; interpret the result.
Y8-007.namedActivity: Multiplier Machine: type a multiplier and watch values change; match each percentage change to its multiplier.

Y8-008.title: Reverse percentages
Y8-008.objective: Find an original amount from a final amount after percentage change.
Y8-008.scope: Identify the multiplier used; divide by it; distinguish reverse percentage from subtracting the percentage.
Y8-008.namedActivity: Reverse Detective: given the new price and the percentage, rewind the bar to find the original.

Y8-009.title: Significant figures and estimation
Y8-009.objective: Round to significant figures and use that rounding to estimate calculations.
Y8-009.scope: Identify the first significant digit; round to a stated number of significant figures; choose sensible approximations; judge whether answers are reasonable.
Y8-009.namedActivity: Sig Fig Sniper: round to significant figures to hit estimation targets and judge calculation sizes.

Y8-010.title: Error intervals and bounds in context
Y8-010.objective: Describe possible values represented by rounded measurements and use those intervals in context.
Y8-010.scope: Write lower and upper bounds; use inequality notation where appropriate; reason about possible values and results without overclaiming precision.
Y8-010.namedActivity: Tolerance Engineer: set measurement bounds so parts fit within machine tolerance.

Y8-011.title: Expanding and simplifying double brackets
Y8-011.objective: Expand products of two binomials and simplify the resulting expression.
Y8-011.scope: Multiply every term systematically; organise products; combine like terms; check structure and signs.
Y8-011.namedActivity: Double Bracket Grid: fill an area model to expand double brackets and match the results.

Y8-012.title: Factorising common factors
Y8-012.objective: Factorise expressions by taking out a common factor.
Y8-012.scope: Identify common numerical/algebraic factors; write equivalent products; verify by expansion.
Y8-012.namedActivity: Factor Finder Quest: factorise to unlock doors, checking each by expanding.

Y8-013.title: Equations with brackets
Y8-013.objective: Solve linear equations that require expanding brackets first.
Y8-013.scope: Expand accurately; collect terms; use inverse operations; check solutions.
Y8-013.namedActivity: Bracket Balance: keep the scale level while expanding brackets and solving.

Y8-014.title: Unknowns on both sides
Y8-014.objective: Solve linear equations with the unknown on both sides.
Y8-014.scope: Collect variable terms strategically; maintain equality; recognise no/infinitely many solutions in simple cases.
Y8-014.namedActivity: Both Sides Battle: remove equal weights from each side until the unknown is isolated.

Y8-015.title: Equations with fractions
Y8-015.objective: Solve linear equations containing simple fractional coefficients.
Y8-015.scope: Clear denominators or use inverse operations; preserve equality; check by substitution.
Y8-015.namedActivity: Fraction Fix: clear denominators to solve equations in quick-fire rounds.

Y8-016.title: Rearranging formulae
Y8-016.objective: Change the subject of formulae using one or more inverse steps.
Y8-016.scope: Identify the target subject; preserve equality; reverse operations in a logical order; check by substituting values where useful.
Y8-016.namedActivity: Subject Switch: rearrange formulae to make a new letter the subject, putting the steps in order.

Y8-017.title: Linear inequalities and number-line solutions
Y8-017.objective: Solve simple linear inequalities and represent their solution sets on number lines.
Y8-017.scope: Interpret inequality symbols; use inverse operations; show open/closed endpoints correctly; read and write solution sets.
Y8-017.namedActivity: Inequality Zone: shade a number line to match each inequality alert.

Y8-018.title: Multi-step and compound inequalities
Y8-018.objective: Solve and interpret multi-step linear inequalities.
Y8-018.scope: Combine algebra and number-line representations; test boundary values; solve contexts.
Y8-018.namedActivity: Compound Corridors: pass gates defined by compound inequalities by choosing values that satisfy all of them.

Y8-019.title: Arithmetic sequences
Y8-019.objective: Generate arithmetic sequences and connect difference to algebraic rules.
Y8-019.scope: Use term-to-term and position-to-term descriptions; identify common difference; test general rules.
Y8-019.namedActivity: Staircase Sequences: climb stairs by the common difference and find the nth term to open the top door.

Y8-020.title: Geometric sequences
Y8-020.scope: Identify common ratio; continue forwards/backwards; distinguish additive from multiplicative patterns.
Y8-020.namedActivity: Doubling Dash: grow geometric sequences with ratio switches and predict term n before the timer ends.

Y8-021.title: Quadratic pattern spotting
Y8-021.objective: Recognise patterns with constant second differences.
Y8-021.scope: Build first/second difference tables; connect to curved growth; avoid assuming every pattern is linear.
Y8-021.namedActivity: Pattern Prospector: find second differences to spot quadratic patterns hidden in tables.

Y8-022.title: Straight-line gradient
Y8-022.objective: Interpret gradient as vertical change per horizontal change.
Y8-022.scope: Calculate rise/run; compare steepness and direction; connect to rate of change.
Y8-022.namedActivity: Hill Climber: climb slopes and calculate gradients to match ramp heights.

Y8-023.title: Y-intercept and y = mx + c
Y8-023.objective: Interpret the y-intercept and use y=mx+c.
Y8-023.scope: Identify m and c; generate lines; connect equation, table and graph.
Y8-023.namedActivity: Line Lab: use sliders for m and c to match the target line.

Y8-024.title: Plotting straight-line graphs
Y8-024.scope: Generate points; choose scales; recognise that many points lie on one line.
Y8-024.namedActivity: Plot the Path: plot lines from tables and equations to guide a rover.

Y8-025.title: Parallel lines and gradient
Y8-025.objective: Use gradient to recognise and construct parallel lines.
Y8-025.scope: Compare m-values; vary intercept; explain why parallel lines never meet.
Y8-025.namedActivity: Parallel Parking: draw lines parallel to a given line by matching its gradient.

Y8-026.title: Distance–time graphs
Y8-026.scope: Read stationary/moving sections; calculate average speed from gradient; compare journeys.
Y8-026.namedActivity: Runner's Story: match distance–time graphs to runner stories and read speeds and stops.

Y8-027.title: Velocity–time graphs
Y8-027.scope: Read direction/speed; interpret constant/changing velocity; connect shape to motion qualitatively.
Y8-027.namedActivity: Speed Tracker: read velocity–time graphs to find acceleration and distance.

Y8-028.title: Gradient as rate of change
Y8-028.objective: Use graph gradient to interpret rates in real contexts.
Y8-028.scope: Choose two points on straight sections; calculate units of gradient; interpret sign.
Y8-028.namedActivity: Rate Detective: use gradient as a rate to work out which tank fills fastest.

Y8-029.title: Simultaneous equations graphically
Y8-029.objective: Find and interpret approximate solutions to pairs of linear relationships from their graph intersection.
Y8-029.scope: Plot or read two lines; locate the intersection; connect the coordinate to both equations; interpret the intersection in context.
Y8-029.namedActivity: Cross Paths: find where two lines meet; the fastest correct intersection wins.

Y8-030.title: Quadratic tables and graphs
Y8-030.objective: Generate values for simple quadratic functions and plot smooth quadratic graphs.
Y8-030.scope: Substitute values systematically; organise tables; plot coordinates accurately; join with an appropriate smooth curve.
Y8-030.namedActivity: Parabola Plotter: fill tables, plot quadratics and launch a projectile along the curve.

Y8-031.title: Features of quadratic graphs
Y8-031.objective: Identify and interpret roots, intercepts, turning points and symmetry on simple quadratic graphs.
Y8-031.scope: Read x- and y-intercepts; estimate roots; locate turning points; identify the line of symmetry; connect features to the graph shape.
Y8-031.namedActivity: Peak Hunter: find the roots, turning point and line of symmetry on a quadratic graph.

Y8-032.title: Comparing linear and quadratic relationships
Y8-032.objective: Compare how linear and quadratic graphs change.
Y8-032.scope: Contrast constant rate with changing rate; connect tables and graph shapes; choose suitable models.
Y8-032.namedActivity: Line or Curve?: classify graphs and match equation cards to compare how fast each grows.

Y8-033.title: Graphical problem solving
Y8-033.objective: Use graphs to estimate solutions and interpret relationships.
Y8-033.scope: Read x for given y and vice versa; estimate intersections; state limits of accuracy.
Y8-033.namedActivity: Graph Escape Room: solve graph clues to unlock each door in turn.

Y8-034.title: Ratio with fractions and decimals
Y8-034.objective: Use ratios involving fractional and decimal quantities.
Y8-034.scope: Standardise units/forms; simplify multiplicatively; interpret part relationships.
Y8-034.namedActivity: Ratio Remix: scale ratios involving fractions and decimals for recipe-style orders.

Y8-035.title: Direct proportion with tables and equations
Y8-035.objective: Represent direct proportion using scale factors, tables and equations of the form y = kx.
Y8-035.scope: Identify the constant of proportionality; scale pairs consistently; form and use y = kx.
Y8-035.namedActivity: Proportion Table Race: complete tables and write equations for direct proportion.

Y8-036.title: Direct proportion graphs
Y8-036.objective: Recognise and use straight-line graphs through the origin for direct proportion.
Y8-036.scope: Connect gradient to k; read values; distinguish from non-proportional linear graphs.
Y8-036.namedActivity: Straight to Zero: match proportional graphs through the origin to their constants.

Y8-037.title: Inverse proportion in tables and graphs
Y8-037.objective: Recognise and represent inverse proportional relationships in practical, numerical and graphical forms.
Y8-037.scope: Identify constant-product structure; complete tables; recognise inverse-shaped graphs; explain how one variable changes as the other changes.
Y8-037.namedActivity: Workers Needed: change workers or time and watch the inverse graph and table respond.

Y8-038.title: Percentage-change problem solving
Y8-038.objective: Solve multi-step increase/decrease and original-value problems.
Y8-038.scope: Choose multiplier or reverse method; compare successive changes; interpret contexts.
Y8-038.namedActivity: Price Change Detective: untangle repeated percentage changes in shop stories.

Y8-039.title: Currency conversion
Y8-039.objective: Convert currencies using given exchange rates.
Y8-039.scope: Treat rates multiplicatively; choose multiply/divide direction; compare value after conversion.
Y8-039.namedActivity: Exchange Desk: convert currencies for travellers before they miss their flight.

Y8-040.title: Wages, deductions and budgeting
Y8-040.objective: Solve problems about earnings, deductions and budgets using percentages and unit prices.
Y8-040.scope: Calculate gross and net pay; apply percentage deductions and VAT using multipliers; read a payslip; build a simple budget from income and spending; compare costs and savings over time.
Y8-040.namedActivity: Pay Day Planner: take a payslip, apply the deductions, then place bills and savings into a budget to finish the month in the black.

Y8-041.title: Speed
Y8-041.objective: Use speed as a compound unit and solve speed–distance–time problems.
Y8-041.scope: Rearrange relationships; convert units; interpret average speed.
Y8-041.namedActivity: Speed Trap: use distance and time to calculate speeds and decide who is speeding.

Y8-042.title: Density
Y8-042.objective: Use density as mass per unit volume.
Y8-042.scope: Connect formula to ratio; rearrange; use consistent units.
Y8-042.namedActivity: Density Detective: calculate mass or volume to identify mystery materials.

Y8-043.title: Compound-unit conversion
Y8-043.objective: Convert and compare rates expressed with compound units.
Y8-043.scope: Track numerator/denominator units; scale correctly; interpret rate meaning.
Y8-043.namedActivity: Unit Relay: convert compound units such as m/s to km/h in a relay.

Y8-044.title: Pythagoras from square areas
Y8-044.objective: Understand Pythagoras’ theorem as a relationship between square areas.
Y8-044.scope: Identify hypotenuse; use a²+b²=c²; distinguish theorem from measurement.
Y8-044.namedActivity: Square Room: arrange squares on a right triangle's sides to see a² + b² = c².

Y8-045.title: Finding unknown sides with Pythagoras
Y8-045.objective: Use Pythagoras’ theorem to find either the hypotenuse or a shorter side in a right triangle.
Y8-045.scope: Identify the hypotenuse correctly; substitute side lengths; rearrange the theorem when needed; check that the result is sensible.
Y8-045.namedActivity: Missing Side Rescue: find the missing side to pick the right ladder for stranded climbers.

Y8-046.title: Pythagoras problem solving
Y8-046.objective: Apply Pythagoras in geometric and contextual problems.
Y8-046.scope: Identify hidden right triangles; choose needed lengths; communicate units.
Y8-046.namedActivity: Pythagoras Pathfinder: choose shortcuts across a map using Pythagoras.

Y8-047.title: Circumference of a circle
Y8-047.objective: Use circle vocabulary and calculate circumference.
Y8-047.scope: Identify radius/diameter/chord/tangent/arc; use C=πd=2πr; keep exact/decimal forms.
Y8-047.namedActivity: Wheel Roll: roll a wheel through one turn to measure circumference and discover pi.

Y8-048.title: Area of a circle
Y8-048.objective: Calculate and solve problems involving circle area.
Y8-048.scope: Use A=πr²; distinguish radius/diameter; compare area changes.
Y8-048.namedActivity: Pizza Area: slice circles into sectors, rearrange them into a rectangle and rank pizzas by area.

Y8-049.title: Interior, exterior and regular-polygon angles
Y8-049.objective: Use interior and exterior angle relationships to solve polygon and regular-polygon problems.
Y8-049.scope: Derive interior sums; connect exterior turns to 360°; use equal-angle structure in regular polygons; solve for unknowns.
Y8-049.namedActivity: Polygon Turns: walk regular polygons, calculating interior and exterior angles to close the loop.

Y8-050.title: Perpendicular and angle-bisector constructions
Y8-050.scope: Construct perpendicular bisectors/perpendiculars/angle bisectors; explain equal-distance properties.
Y8-050.namedActivity: Bisector Builder: construct bisectors to place a lamppost fairly between houses.

Y8-051.title: Loci
Y8-051.objective: Describe and construct loci from distance conditions.
Y8-051.scope: Interpret equal distance from point/line; combine loci; identify feasible regions.
Y8-051.namedActivity: Treasure Locus: find the region equidistant from points and lines to dig for treasure.

Y8-052.title: Bearings
Y8-052.scope: Measure clockwise from north; draw accurate diagrams; solve reverse-bearing problems.
Y8-052.namedActivity: Pilot's Bearing: set three-figure bearings to fly planes to the right airports.

Y8-053.title: Reflection and translation
Y8-053.scope: Use coordinate rules/vectors informally; preserve congruence; compare image and object.
Y8-053.namedActivity: Slide and Mirror: move shapes to targets using reflections and translations.

Y8-054.title: Rotation
Y8-054.scope: Specify centre, angle, direction; track vertices; identify invariants.
Y8-054.namedActivity: Rotation Station: rotate about different centres to land in the target zone.

Y8-055.title: Enlargement
Y8-055.objective: Construct enlargements with positive scale factors.
Y8-055.scope: Use centre of enlargement; scale distances; distinguish similarity from congruence.
Y8-055.namedActivity: Zoom Factor: enlarge shapes with negative and fractional factors to land on the target grid.

Y8-056.title: Triangle congruence
Y8-056.objective: Apply SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS to decide congruence.
Y8-056.scope: Identify sufficient data; match corresponding parts; use congruence to infer equal lengths/angles.
Y8-056.namedActivity: Congruent Cards: pair triangles by SSS, SAS, ASA or RHS.

Y8-057.title: Similarity
Y8-057.objective: Use scale factors with similar shapes.
Y8-057.scope: Identify corresponding sides; calculate missing lengths; connect enlargement to similarity.
Y8-057.namedActivity: Similar Spotter: find similar shapes by matching scale factors, then calculate the missing sides.

Y8-058.title: Nets and 3-D shapes
Y8-058.objective: Interpret and construct nets of prisms and other solids.
Y8-058.scope: Relate 2-D faces to 3-D form; count faces/edges/vertices; test valid nets.
Y8-058.namedActivity: Net Folder: fold nets into solids and reject the invalid ones.

Y8-059.title: Plans and elevations
Y8-059.objective: Construct and interpret plans and elevations.
Y8-059.scope: View solids from top/front/side; translate between 3-D and 2-D representations.
Y8-059.namedActivity: Blueprint Match: match plans and elevations to the right 3D cube model.

Y8-060.title: Volume of prisms
Y8-060.objective: Calculate volumes of prisms using cross-sectional area × length.
Y8-060.scope: Identify constant cross-section; use area formulae; use cubic units.
Y8-060.namedActivity: Prism Packer: use area times length to fill containers exactly.

Y8-061.title: Surface area of prisms
Y8-061.objective: Calculate surface area by summing faces or using nets.
Y8-061.scope: Identify all faces; avoid omission/double-counting; use square units.
Y8-061.namedActivity: Wrap It Up: unfold prisms to find the surface area for wrapping paper.

Y8-062.title: Volume of cylinders
Y8-062.objective: Calculate the volume of a cylinder.
Y8-062.scope: Use circular cross-sectional area × length/height; keep units consistent; solve direct and reverse problems.
Y8-062.namedActivity: Can Filler: stack discs to fill cylinders and match juice orders by volume.

Y8-063.title: Surface area of cylinders
Y8-063.objective: Calculate the surface area of a cylinder.
Y8-063.scope: Identify two circular ends and the curved rectangle; use circumference × height for curved area; combine areas with correct units.
Y8-063.namedActivity: Label Maker: unroll cylinders to find the surface area for can labels.

Y8-064.title: Grouped frequency tables
Y8-064.objective: Interpret grouped numerical data in frequency tables.
Y8-064.scope: Read class intervals; identify modal class; recognise loss of exact raw values.
Y8-064.namedActivity: Group Data Dash: sort raw data into class intervals quickly and accurately.

Y8-065.title: Estimating the mean from grouped data
Y8-065.objective: Estimate a mean using class midpoints.
Y8-065.scope: Find midpoints; calculate fx; divide by total frequency; explain why result is an estimate.
Y8-065.namedActivity: Mean Estimator: use midpoints to estimate means and compare with the actual value.

Y8-066.title: Scatter graphs and lines of best fit
Y8-066.objective: Plot and interpret bivariate data and use a sensible line of best fit.
Y8-066.scope: Identify correlation; plot points accurately; draw a representative trend line; interpolate cautiously and describe limitations.
Y8-066.namedActivity: Scatter Scout: plot data, draw a line of best fit and predict missing values.

Y8-067.title: Two-way tables
Y8-067.scope: Use row/column totals; identify intersections; calculate proportions/probabilities.
Y8-067.namedActivity: Table Detective: complete two-way tables to crack the case.

Y8-068.title: Frequency trees
Y8-068.objective: Represent changing totals through categories using frequency trees.
Y8-068.scope: Fill missing branches; track totals; connect to two-way tables.
Y8-068.namedActivity: Frequency Tree: fill in a frequency tree and read probabilities from it.

Y8-069.title: Comparing distributions
Y8-069.objective: Compare data sets using averages and spread.
Y8-069.scope: Use centre and range together; account for outliers; write evidence-based comparisons.
Y8-069.namedActivity: Compare the Crowds: use averages and spread to settle arguments between two groups.

Y8-070.title: Combined-event sample spaces and probability
Y8-070.objective: Build structured sample spaces for two events and calculate probabilities from them.
Y8-070.scope: List outcomes systematically; avoid omissions/duplicates; count favourable outcomes; form probabilities from the complete sample space.
Y8-070.namedActivity: Sample Space Sprint: list every outcome of combined events and compute the chances.

Y8-071.title: Independent tree diagrams
Y8-071.objective: Use tree diagrams for independent repeated events.
Y8-071.scope: Place branch probabilities; multiply along paths; add mutually exclusive path probabilities.
Y8-071.namedActivity: Tree Track: multiply along branches to find the chance of each path.

Y8-072.title: Venn diagrams and set notation
Y8-072.objective: Represent sets and events with Venn diagrams and basic set notation.
Y8-072.scope: Place elements in correct regions; interpret union, intersection and complement language; connect notation to diagram regions.
Y8-072.namedActivity: Venn Sort: place items in set regions and answer set-notation challenges.

Y8-073.title: Experimental and theoretical probability
Y8-073.objective: Compare experimental relative frequencies with theoretical models.
Y8-073.scope: Predict long-run behaviour; explain sampling variation; evaluate fairness.
Y8-073.namedActivity: Theory vs Practice: simulate many trials and compare experimental with theoretical probability.

Y9-001.title: The real number system
Y9-001.objective: Classify integers, rational numbers and irrational numbers within the real numbers.
Y9-001.scope: Recognise terminating/recurring rational forms; identify irrational examples; understand number sets continue infinitely.
Y9-001.namedActivity: Number Sorter: sort numbers into natural, integer, rational and irrational sets.

Y9-002.title: Powers, roots and exact values
Y9-002.objective: Use integer powers and associated roots and distinguish exact from approximate values.
Y9-002.scope: Evaluate powers/roots; keep exact root form when appropriate; use decimal approximations sensibly.
Y9-002.namedActivity: Surd Simplifier: simplify roots using area squares and keep exact values to open the vault.

Y9-003.title: Fractional indices
Y9-003.objective: Interpret and calculate with unit-fraction and fractional indices as roots and powers.
Y9-003.scope: Link powers of one half and one third to square and cube roots; extend to a to the power m over n as a root then a power; apply the index laws to fractional indices; evaluate perfect powers without a calculator; check with a calculator.
Y9-003.namedActivity: Root Reactor: dial the numerator and denominator of an index to charge the reactor, choosing root-then-power to hit exact target values.

Y9-004.title: Measurement error and estimation
Y9-004.objective: Use error intervals and estimation to reason about the possible accuracy of measurements and calculated results.
Y9-004.scope: Express possible values with inequalities; estimate results; distinguish rounded values from exact values; discuss possible error appropriately.
Y9-004.namedActivity: Tolerance Tester: judge whether measurements fit within error limits and estimate sizes.

Y9-005.title: Fractions, decimals and percentages as operators
Y9-005.objective: Move flexibly between fractions, decimals and percentages and use them as multiplicative operators.
Y9-005.scope: Convert representations; interpret percentages above 100%; apply values to quantities; select the representation that makes a problem easiest.
Y9-005.namedActivity: Operator Orchestra: apply fractions, decimals and percentages as operators to chains of values.

Y9-006.title: Algebraic equivalence
Y9-006.objective: Recognise and prove simple algebraic equivalence.
Y9-006.scope: Use expansion/factorisation; compare structure; distinguish example-checking from general justification.
Y9-006.namedActivity: Equivalence Court: decide whether two expressions are equivalent using value tests and expansion.

Y9-007.title: Modelling with expressions and formulae
Y9-007.objective: Translate complex contexts into algebraic expressions or formulae.
Y9-007.scope: Define variables; model repeated/proportional relationships; interpret terms.
Y9-007.namedActivity: Model Maker: build formulae from real situations, then test them with values.

Y9-008.title: Quadratic pattern structure
Y9-008.objective: Recognise simple quadratic patterns through second differences and visual growth.
Y9-008.scope: Use difference tables; connect to n²-type structure; predict later terms without formal quadratic nth-term formula.
Y9-008.namedActivity: Quadratic Pattern Lab: spot the structure of a quadratic sequence and write its rule.

Y9-009.title: Coordinates and algebra
Y9-009.objective: Connect coordinate patterns with algebraic relationships.
Y9-009.scope: Use coordinates in all quadrants; identify constraints; form simple rules.
Y9-009.namedActivity: Algebra Map: link coordinates and equations to find where points sit on a map.

Y9-010.title: Straight-line equations and problem solving
Y9-010.objective: Use y = mx + c to represent, analyse and solve problems involving straight lines.
Y9-010.scope: Identify and calculate gradient and intercept; form equations; compare lines; solve numerical and graphical problems from context.
Y9-010.namedActivity: Line Detective: find equations of lines from points and gradients to solve problems.

Y9-011.title: Features of quadratic graphs
Y9-011.objective: Use quadratic graphs to estimate roots and intercepts and identify turning points and symmetry.
Y9-011.scope: Read roots/intercepts; identify a turning point; locate the line of symmetry; connect these features to the graph shape.
Y9-011.namedActivity: Arch Designer: design a bridge arch using the roots and turning point of a quadratic.

Y9-012.title: Linear versus quadratic models
Y9-012.objective: Decide whether a context is better represented linearly or quadratically.
Y9-012.scope: Compare difference patterns; compare graph shapes; interpret model limitations.
Y9-012.namedActivity: Model Showdown: decide whether a linear or quadratic model fits the data, and justify it.

Y9-013.title: Reciprocal graphs in context
Y9-013.objective: Interpret reciprocal-shaped relationships from given graphs.
Y9-013.scope: Recognise inverse-type behaviour; read values; discuss asymptotic trends informally.
Y9-013.namedActivity: Reciprocal Racer: explore inverse relationships and match reciprocal graphs to stories.

Y9-014.title: Exponential graphs in context
Y9-014.objective: Interpret rapidly increasing/decreasing relationships from given graphs.
Y9-014.scope: Recognise multiplicative change; compare with linear growth; read approximate values.
Y9-014.namedActivity: Growth Gamble: compare linear and exponential growth over time to choose the best deal.

Y9-015.title: Piecewise and non-standard graphs
Y9-015.objective: Interpret graphs made of different behaviours across intervals.
Y9-015.scope: Read changing rules; identify discontinuities/corners; connect graph sections to context.
Y9-015.namedActivity: Graph Zoo: match piecewise and unusual graphs to the stories they tell.

Y9-016.title: Distance–time problem solving
Y9-016.objective: Analyse complex journeys using distance–time graphs.
Y9-016.scope: Interpret gradient and stops; calculate rates; compare journeys.
Y9-016.namedActivity: Journey Planner: plan a multi-stage trip using distance–time graphs.

Y9-017.title: Velocity–time interpretation
Y9-017.objective: Interpret changing velocity and direction from graphs.
Y9-017.scope: Read positive/negative velocity; compare constant/changing motion; interpret intersections with axes.
Y9-017.namedActivity: Rocket Reader: read velocity–time graphs to find a rocket's acceleration and distance.

Y9-018.title: Graphical solutions and modelling
Y9-018.objective: Use graphs to find approximate solutions and evaluate models.
Y9-018.scope: Find intersections; read estimates with sensible precision; explain graph limitations.
Y9-018.namedActivity: Meet in the Middle: find where two models meet graphically and choose the better one.

Y9-019.title: Inverse proportion algebraically
Y9-019.objective: Represent simple inverse proportion with constant-product relationships.
Y9-019.scope: Use xy=k; calculate missing values; interpret how variables co-vary.
Y9-019.namedActivity: Inverse Workforce: set up inverse proportion equations to staff projects on time.

Y9-020.title: Direct and inverse proportion graphs
Y9-020.objective: Recognise graphical signatures of proportional relationships.
Y9-020.scope: Identify origin line for direct proportion; interpret inverse curves from data; connect graph to equation.
Y9-020.namedActivity: Proportion Graph Match: match direct and inverse graphs to equations and stories.

Y9-021.title: Scale factors and maps
Y9-021.objective: Use scale factors across drawings, maps and similar figures.
Y9-021.scope: Convert actual/drawing lengths; choose units; reason multiplicatively.
Y9-021.namedActivity: Scale Architect: use scale factors to enlarge or reduce plans and maps accurately.

Y9-022.title: Speed and rates
Y9-022.objective: Solve multi-step problems involving speed and other rates.
Y9-022.scope: Rearrange rate relationships; convert time/distance units; interpret average rates.
Y9-022.namedActivity: Rate Racer: solve speed and rate problems across a multi-stage race.

Y9-023.title: Density
Y9-023.objective: Solve density, mass and volume problems.
Y9-023.scope: Use density=m/V; rearrange; manage compound units.
Y9-023.namedActivity: Mystery Material: use density to identify materials from their mass and volume.

Y9-024.title: Mixed compound units
Y9-024.objective: Solve unfamiliar problems involving compound rates.
Y9-024.scope: Track units through calculations; convert compound units; choose proportional methods.
Y9-024.namedActivity: Unit Chain: convert mixed compound units in multi-step chains.

Y9-025.title: Angle reasoning with parallel lines
Y9-025.objective: Build multi-step angle arguments using line and parallel-line facts.
Y9-025.scope: Use corresponding/alternate/vertically opposite facts; form equations; state reasons.
Y9-025.namedActivity: Angle Escape: chase angles using parallel lines and give reasons to escape.

Y9-026.title: Polygon angle reasoning
Y9-026.objective: Use interior/exterior angle relationships in polygons.
Y9-026.scope: Derive sums; solve regular/irregular problems; infer side counts.
Y9-026.namedActivity: Polygon Proof: find unknown angles in polygons with reasoned steps.

Y9-027.title: Loci problems
Y9-027.objective: Solve problems involving intersections of loci.
Y9-027.scope: Translate conditions into loci; combine regions; identify all valid positions.
Y9-027.namedActivity: Locus Planner: place a wi-fi router or fire station using locus regions.

Y9-028.title: Congruence reasoning
Y9-028.objective: Use triangle congruence to justify equal lengths and angles.
Y9-028.scope: Apply SSS/SAS/ASA/RHS; identify correspondence; build short proofs.
Y9-028.namedActivity: Congruence Proof Builder: put reasons in order to prove triangles congruent.

Y9-029.title: Similarity reasoning
Y9-029.objective: Use similarity to calculate missing lengths and justify relationships.
Y9-029.scope: Find linear scale factors; match corresponding sides; connect to enlargement.
Y9-029.namedActivity: Similarity Surveyor: measure heights and distances using similar triangles.

Y9-030.title: Pythagoras mastery
Y9-030.scope: Identify right triangles; choose hypotenuse/shorter-side form; round appropriately.
Y9-030.namedActivity: Pythagoras Pro: solve multi-step Pythagoras problems in 2D scenes.

Y9-031.title: Trigonometric ratios
Y9-031.objective: Understand sine, cosine and tangent as side ratios in similar right triangles.
Y9-031.scope: Label opposite/adjacent/hypotenuse; choose SOH/CAH/TOA; explain why ratio depends on angle.
Y9-031.namedActivity: Ratio Ramp: label opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse and build trig ratios with an angle slider.

Y9-032.title: Trigonometry: finding sides
Y9-032.objective: Use trigonometric ratios to find unknown side lengths.
Y9-032.scope: Choose ratio; form equation; use calculator; interpret precision.
Y9-032.namedActivity: Ladder Safety: use trig to find sides of ladders, ramps and slopes.

Y9-033.title: Trigonometry: finding angles
Y9-033.objective: Use inverse trigonometric functions to find angles.
Y9-033.scope: Choose ratio from known sides; use inverse function; check angle size.
Y9-033.namedActivity: Angle Finder: use inverse trig to find the angle for a launch ramp.

Y9-034.title: Circle vocabulary and circumference
Y9-034.objective: Use precise circle vocabulary and solve circumference problems, including reverse problems.
Y9-034.scope: Identify radius, diameter, chord, arc, sector and tangent; use C = πd = 2πr; rearrange and interpret answers in context.
Y9-034.namedActivity: Circle Anatomy: label the parts of a circle and measure circumference.

Y9-035.title: Area of circles and composite shapes
Y9-035.objective: Calculate areas involving circles and composite shapes.
Y9-035.scope: Use πr²; subtract/add regions; manage units.
Y9-035.namedActivity: Composite Garden: calculate areas of circles and composite shapes to cost a garden.

Y9-036.title: Volume of prisms and cylinders
Y9-036.objective: Use cross-sectional area × length for prisms and cylinders.
Y9-036.scope: Identify constant cross-section; combine circle/other area formulae; use cubic units.
Y9-036.namedActivity: Silo Fill: find prism and cylinder volumes and fill tanks to a target level.

Y9-037.title: Surface area
Y9-037.objective: Calculate surface area of prisms and cylinders using nets/face structure.
Y9-037.scope: Identify faces/surfaces; use circumference for curved rectangle model; use square units.
Y9-037.namedActivity: Paint the Solid: find surface areas to order the right amount of paint.

Y9-038.title: 3-D solid properties
Y9-038.objective: Use faces, surfaces, edges and vertices of prisms, pyramids, cones and spheres to solve problems.
Y9-038.scope: Classify solids; reason from cross-sections/nets; connect 2-D and 3-D features.
Y9-038.namedActivity: Solid Sorter: sort solids by faces, edges and vertices and slice cross-sections.

Y9-039.title: Bearings
Y9-039.scope: Use three-figure bearings; draw north lines; combine angle facts.
Y9-039.namedActivity: Navigator: plot bearing journeys and compute the return bearings.

Y9-040.title: Coordinate geometry
Y9-040.objective: Use coordinates to reason about shape and transformation properties.
Y9-040.scope: Use gradients/distances informally; identify parallel/perpendicular structure; solve missing-coordinate problems.
Y9-040.namedActivity: Coordinate Quest: find midpoints and distances on a grid to locate hidden targets.

Y9-041.title: Simple geometric proof
Y9-041.objective: Write short deductive arguments using known geometric facts.
Y9-041.scope: State givens; chain reasons; use congruence/similarity/angle facts without relying on appearance.
Y9-041.namedActivity: Proof Pieces: put the steps of a simple geometric proof in the right order with reasons.

Y9-042.title: Probability models
Y9-042.objective: Build theoretical probability models from equally likely outcomes.
Y9-042.scope: Define outcomes; calculate probabilities; check total probability equals 1.
Y9-042.namedActivity: Probability Lab: build a probability model and test it against simulations.

Y9-043.title: Sample spaces and combined-event probability
Y9-043.objective: Generate sample spaces systematically and use them to calculate probabilities for combined events.
Y9-043.scope: List outcomes without omissions; identify favourable outcomes; calculate probabilities from equally likely sample spaces; justify the model.
Y9-043.namedActivity: Combined Chances: list outcomes and compute combined-event probabilities.

Y9-044.title: Sets, unions and intersections
Y9-044.objective: Represent probability events with Venn diagrams and set language.
Y9-044.scope: Use union/intersection/complement; place frequencies/probabilities; avoid double counting.
Y9-044.namedActivity: Set Sorter: sort items into union and intersection regions using set notation.

Y9-045.title: Independent events
Y9-045.objective: Use multiplication for independent events in simple cases.
Y9-045.scope: Recognise independence; use tree/sample-space reasoning; multiply along outcomes.
Y9-045.namedActivity: Independent or Not?: decide whether events are independent, then multiply probabilities.

Y9-046.title: Experimental probability and relative frequency
Y9-046.objective: Compare experimental results with theoretical probability and use relative frequency to make predictions.
Y9-046.scope: Calculate relative frequency; compare observed and expected outcomes; explain variation; make cautious predictions from repeated trials.
Y9-046.namedActivity: Fair Dice Detective: use relative frequency to spot unfair dice and spinners.

Y9-047.title: Grouped data representations
Y9-047.objective: Choose and interpret appropriate representations for grouped data.
Y9-047.scope: Read grouped frequency tables/vertical line or bar charts; recognise class intervals; identify limitations.
Y9-047.namedActivity: Histogram Builder: build charts from grouped data and read off estimates.

Y9-048.title: Averages, spread and outliers
Y9-048.objective: Compare distributions using centre and spread.
Y9-048.scope: Use mean/median/mode and range; discuss outliers; choose suitable summaries.
Y9-048.namedActivity: Outlier Hunt: spot outliers and see how they change averages and spread.

Y9-049.title: Comparing distributions
Y9-049.objective: Write evidence-based comparisons between data sets.
Y9-049.scope: Compare typical value and variation; reference graph shape/outliers; avoid unsupported claims.
Y9-049.namedActivity: Distribution Debate: compare two datasets in a debate using averages and spread.

Y9-050.title: Scatter graphs and correlation
Y9-050.objective: Interpret bivariate data and explain correlation without assuming causation.
Y9-050.scope: Identify direction and strength of correlation; spot outliers; describe relationships; explain why correlation alone does not prove cause.
Y9-050.namedActivity: Correlation Spotter: classify scatter graphs by type and strength of correlation.

Y9-051.title: Lines of best fit and prediction
Y9-051.objective: Use lines of best fit for interpolation and cautious extrapolation.
Y9-051.scope: Draw sensible line; make estimates; discuss reliability inside/outside data range.
Y9-051.namedActivity: Predictor: draw best-fit lines and predict values, with reliability warnings.

Y9-052.title: Sampling and bias
Y9-052.objective: Evaluate how data-collection choices can bias conclusions.
Y9-052.scope: Identify population/sample; spot leading/unrepresentative methods; improve survey design.
Y9-052.namedActivity: Bias Buster: spot bias in samples and design a fairer one.
